summary: The DevicesMFE class is a comprehensive Page Object Model for the myHP Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) interface. It extends HPXFlow and provides extensive verification and action methods for UI automation testing. The class implements the Page Object pattern with methods divided into verification flows (checking element presence, visibility, and states) and action flows (clicking, scrolling, navigation). Key features include: handling Windows dummy printers for testing, managing login/logout states, device card interactions, window controls (maximize/minimize/close), profile and settings navigation, and popup dialog handling. The class uses Selenium WebDriver with custom driver wrapper methods (wait_for_object, click, get_attribute) and includes retry logic, change checks, and timeout configurations. It also implements screenshot comparison for visual validation and handles multiple UI states across different environments (stage/prod). Notable patterns include conditional element checking, JavaScript execution for hidden elements, keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+R for refresh, END/PAGE_DOWN for scrolling), and comprehensive error handling for various popup dialogs.
